Mech.desc: Boasts cutting edge military technology. Powerful core stats, but expensive and have few special abilities.

Beast.desc: The creatures of Azeroth are no strangers to war. A balanced race overall. Also pretty inexpensive in cost.

Shadow.desc: Specializes in dark magic. High damage fighters with a good balance of offensive and defensive abilities.

Nature.desc: Defensive race. Slow, but very resilient and have excellent abilities. All fighters have slight life regeneration.

Element.desc: Forces of magic far older than life itself. An offensive race.

Ghost.desc: Having transcended the physical world, fighters have strong offensive magic and ranged attacks. Weak on defense.

Demi-Human.desc: A motley crew of species with similarities to the human race. Fighters boast versatile abilities.

Hybrid.desc:
A strange race with no characteristics of its own. Instead, morphs into fighters from other races.

Cannot be randomed or drafted
Hybrid.rule: 变形体: 建造后在每阶的16个种族基础兵中随机变形为其一(详见tooltip)

Marine.desc: From the depths of the ocean rise creatures unlike any other.

Arctic.desc: The creatures of Nortrend, master of cold.

Elf.desc: The first race to awaken on Azeroth. Fighters have mastered powerful offensive spells, but lack in the area of support. A haughty, selfish race.

Goblin.desc: Goblins are small humanoids. They constantly build and repair machines and work on new ideas. Very strong in mechanical thing and firearm.

Paladin.desc: The noble warriors of humanity employ both a strong military and powerful healer in the defense of their shining kingdoms.

Prophet.desc: Powerful diviner, he can build tower from all race.
Prophet.rule: 可建造所有种族的兵种(85个基础兵)；单机版实现：每阶从全种族随机给出1个，可花费金/木重随(Change Tower: 5次, 50/100/150..金木 递增)

Orc.desc: Strong in melee. Specializes in healing aura (regeneration) and debuff.

Undead.desc: The horrifying Undead army, consists of thousands of walking corpses and powerful necromantic magics.

king.note: 国王击杀漏怪的赏金平分给本队玩家。另有 R006/R007 (国王护甲/攻速) 由脚本在特定时点+2，触发条件未完全确认
king.abilityNote: 《Legion TD Mega Book 3.41》: 国王在第5关获得第一个技能，之后随游戏进行获得其余技能；具体解锁关卡未能从地图脚本确认（技能来自法术书A051/A052），此处按每4关解锁一个估计。满级国王约18750HP、364-374攻击、~100回复。

lateGame.note: R006/R007 由脚本随时间提升国王护甲/攻速；Book称后期攻速约0.4，此处按每关+3%攻速、+0.2护甲估计

economy.startNote: JASS: x3模式(默认 -aphgggmmcbx3) 开局270金/90木；非x3模式100金/30木
economy.upgradeCost: 单位所列金币为总价值，升级时支付差价（与Mega Book出兵顺序吻合）

wisp.harvest: 每次2木（Awha DataA1=2），间隔按《Mega Book》收入数据校准为约3秒/次（第5关25-35收入、第10关110-120收入）

lumberjack.R003: 等级1-8: 金/木 60+20×(n-1)，每级每次采集+1木

farm.note: 农场可连续升级10次，每级+8人口

economy.income: 每回合结束: 关卡奖励 bonusGold(Yv, 第10/20关×2) + 收入(ox: 购买的召唤兵/国王升级累计 income)；击杀赏金即时获得
economy.prepTime: 第i关前准备时间 = 40 + i/2 秒
economy.sell: 出售返还总价值50%，当回合新建的兵返还100%
economy.leak: 漏怪走向国王；3.41: 漏怪超过150后赏金为0(据3.41更新日志)

waveAttackArmorLists.note: JASS 波次说明字符串中的攻击/护甲类型列表，与SLK一致

X3.zh: X3（原版常用：每关36只螃蟹等）

X1.zh: X1（数量1/3，赏金×3 以保持经济，赏金倍率为估计）

bookNotes.creepHpDiff: Book 列出的前期怪物HP略高于物体数据（如螃蟹34 vs 30、蝎子63 vs 55），疑为难度/HP修正科技(R004)所致；本作采用地图物体数据。
